However, significant financial constraints and operational inefficiencies severely limit its current effectiveness. In FY2025, the organization reported a <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $334,780</cite>, representing a steep revenue drop from previous years. A primary operational limitation is its spending allocation: the organization directs a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 42.9%</cite> toward direct services, which falls well below the 75% industry baseline and the peer median. Consequently, over half of expenditures go toward administrative or non-program overhead. While it maintains <cite id="1">9.0 months of working capital</cite> to cushion short-term operations, sustained deficit spending poses ongoing sustainability challenges. Additionally, this charity is strictly sadaqah-eligible.
